senses.gloss: m. (cmp. בַּר I; corresp. to h. סִיב) covering, bast, bark (Syr. נברא fibrae palmarum, P. Sm. 2273).
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 30b:11">Sabb. 30ᵇ</cite> <he>וְאַכְּלֵי מילת נ׳ בר קורא</he> and as to (something corresponding to) fine woolen garments, he showed him the bark of a young palm-shoot.

<cite ref="Shabbat 90b:4">Ib. 90ᵇ</cite> <he>דיקלא דחד נ׳</he> (ed. <he>נבארא</he>) a palm which has only one covering; <cite ref="Eruvin 58a:7">Erub. 58ᵃ</cite> (expl. <cite ref="N01261"><he>נרגילא</he></cite>) <he>דיקלא דחד נ׳</he> (a rope made of fibres of) a palm &c.—
<cite ref="Chullin 51b:16">Ḥull. 51ᵇ</cite> <he>נ׳ חיישינן</he> if an animal fell upon a pile of dried bark, we apprehend internal injury (v. <cite ref="T00659"><he>רִיסּוּק</he></cite>).
